title: 七時十二分の各停
subject: 毎朝同じ各停に乗る
caption: Post-Vocaloid Japanese band pop. Tightly quantised sixteenth-note hi-hats, synth bass doubling a picked electric bass exactly, staccato piano stabs, pitched-up backing vocal stacks used as a pad. Female lead singing at Vocaloid syllable density, breath taken in obvious places because a human has to. 158 BPM, E minor. Flat, at capacity, not complaining. No orchestral strings, no EDM drop, no ballad section, no gated reverb.
lyrics:
[Intro - hats and synth bass]

[Chorus]
七時十二分の各停 三両目
扉の横が空いてる確率 だいたい四割
今日は空いてた
 それだけ

[Verse 1]
家賃を上げると言われたのが先月

残った一つも 言えなかった
更新の紙は冷蔵庫に貼ってある

[Chorus]

 それだけ

[Instrumental Break - synth arpeggio]
